notes: HARD GATE: productivity formula implemented literally; loader emits assertion failure if any per-hour FRED ID is added to FRED_INPUTS. | 2026-07-01 DF-1 REMEDIATED (SWEEP-ch1417-01): the 2012+ productivity denominator was FRED B4701C0A222NBEA, which is 'Hours worked by full-time and part-time employees' (BEA NIPA T6.9, millions of hours), NOT full-time-equivalent EMPLOYEES.
